title: The Railway Children
author: E. Nesbit
short_summary: After their father mysteriously disappears, siblings Roberta (Bobbie), Peter, and Phyllis move with their mother to a small cottage in the countryside, right next to a railway line. There, the children befriend the trains and passengers they see every day, including a kind Old Gentleman, and have a series of adventures before finally learning the truth about their father.
extended_summary:
When the children's father is suddenly and mysteriously taken away, their comfortable life in London ends, and Roberta, Peter, and Phyllis move with their mother to a modest cottage they nickname 'Three Chimneys,' near a busy railway line. Money is tight and their mother works hard to support them, but the children find endless fascination in the trains passing by each day, and they begin waving to an Old Gentleman who always rides the same train and becomes their trusted friend.

Over the course of the story, the children have several exciting adventures connected to the railway — they help prevent a terrible accident by warning a train about a landslide, rescue a boy injured in a tunnel, and help a Russian exile searching for his family. Through it all, the mystery of why their father disappeared hangs over them, until the children's courage, kindness, and the help of their new friend the Old Gentleman lead to a joyful reunion when the truth comes out and their father is proven innocent and returns home.
